# SkillFocus

`world-system`

Dedication: XP in a skill is multiplied by 1 + maxBonus x (active minutes in the last focus window) / window, counted in play time. A skill with no focus earns the normal rate.

> Reward a player for sticking with one skill without ever punishing trying another (Phase 272)

## Attributes

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| focusWindowMinutes | integer | Minutes of play time the focus looks back over |
| maxBonus | decimal | XP bonus (0.25 = +25%) with a full window of activity in one skill |
